verdict.rationale: logo-design-skill is a local Agent Skills package: a SKILL.md folder plus dependency-free Python tools, installed into an agent. It has no hosted service, API or account system, so issuing scoped API credentials is outside this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any credential or API capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
